homepageTopArticles.title: Why Smart Brands Are Rethinking Discovery in the Age of AI
homepageTopArticles.snippet: The shopping journey used to start with a search bar. Now it starts with a conversation. Consumers are increasingly turning to artificial intelligence tools to research products, compare options, and make decisions before they ever land on a brand’s website, walk into a store, or open an app. For retailers, the immediate challenge is visibility: […]
